questions.question: Which language should the mobile service use?
questions.rationale: Flutter applications use Dart and the request explicitly requires Flutter.

questions.question: Which framework and platform target should the mobile service use?
questions.rationale: The requested product is a Flutter Android-first app; iOS compatibility should remain possible through Flutter.

options.label: Flutter for Android-first mobile
options.description: Build Android as the primary target while retaining Flutter's cross-platform path.

questions.question: Which data stores should the application use?
questions.rationale: Tasks must work offline; structured task and recurrence data belongs in SQLite, while optional images belong in app-private local files.

options.label: SQLite local database
options.description: Offline structured storage for tasks, recurrence rules, and completion history.

options.label: Local file storage
options.description: App-private storage for task image attachments.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only for a stateless app with no local or remote persistence.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to access application features?
questions.rationale: The requested experience is a personal offline-first scheduler and does not imply accounts, sharing, or synchronization.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require users to sign in before using application API features.
